subject: Monogram Gourmet Foods TIF and FY2021 Tax Rate
overview: The Council approved a Tax Increment Financing (TIF) agreement for Monogram Gourmet Foods and set the FY2021 tax rate with a maximum shift to lower the burden on residential owners. Several business licenses and a body art permit were granted, while a proposal to limit plastic utensil use failed.

items.title: Food Truck Licensing Extension
items.summary: The Council received and placed on file a request from the Mayor to extend temporary food truck licensing, with members citing concerns regarding the impact on brick-and-mortar restaurants and the lack of specific locations.

items.title: Monogram Gourmet Foods TIF Agreement
items.summary: Approved a Tax Increment Financing agreement for Monogram Gourmet Foods to support a $40 million facility renovation and 250 jobs, including amendments requiring 90-day notice for corporate changes and a request to discuss labor agreements.

items.title: New Business Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Rose's Chinese Restaurant and the Medford Sons of Italy.

items.title: FY2021 Property Tax Rate Hearing
items.summary: Adopted the lowest possible residential factor to maximize the tax shift toward commercial property, though the Council voted against implementing residential or small commercial exemptions at this time.

items.title: Special Permit: Last Night Tattoo Studio
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a body art establishment at 507 High Street with an amendment requiring a 90-day review and a community meeting.

items.title: National Grid Riverside Avenue Gas Main Project
items.summary: Tabled the petition and referred it to a Committee of the Whole to include the MWRA and discuss required mitigation measures for curbing and pavement restoration.

items.title: Parking Policy and Enforcement Commission Update
items.summary: Received a briefing from the commission chairs on their charge to evaluate current city parking policies, enforcement methods, and the impact of the Green Line Extension.

items.title: Infrastructure and Public Safety Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting reports on brown water in South Medford, tree trimming at Anheuser-Busch, marking parking spaces on Governor’s Avenue, and removing trash on Fellsway West.

items.title: COVID-19 Mitigation and Memorial Resolutions
items.summary: Passed resolutions requesting updates on COVID-19 mitigation plans, enforcement policies for safety violations, and establishing a commission for a future pandemic memorial.

items.title: Plastic Utensil Guidance for Restaurants
items.summary: A resolution to establish guidance that restaurants only provide plastic utensils for takeout and delivery upon request failed.

items.title: Short-Term Rental Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a draft ordinance regulating short-term rentals like Airbnb to the Subcommittee on Ordinances.
